Oda narrates (her own voice, woman_relaxed); the rest are the speakers' game voices. voice.py renders each into test_results/cine2/vo/<id>.mp3; shoot_opening.gd shows them as subtitles and mix.py places them, both from this file. at = seconds into the shot.

lines.text: For fifty years, the Hegemony ruled this world.
Then its heart gave out, and the whole thing came apart.
Their great ships came down like rain. Nobody ever cleaned them up.
The rich still throw their parties out on the dunes.
What's left of their army still holds the desert.
Halt! Back in the dirt, sand rat.
Out in the basin, folk race for coin. Not all of them make it home.
They are hardly even a remnant of what they once were. But they still have a hold.
Sir, a ship has just entered orbit. They are landing at the port.
And who do we have here?
Dust ale. That'll be four credits.
And now somebody new just fell out of our sky.
Oh my. That one is going to need a lot of work.
